claims.text: Postpartum hemorrhage is blood loss > 1000 mL, or blood loss with symptoms or signs of hypovolemia, within 24 hours after childbirth.
claims.quote: Postpartum hemorrhage is blood loss of > 1000 mL or blood loss accompanied by symptoms or signs of hypovolemia within 24 hours after childbirth.

claims.text: Tranexamic acid 1 g IV over 10 minutes if initial medical management is ineffective.
claims.quote: Tranexamic acid can also be used if initial medical management is ineffective (1 g IV over 10 minutes).

claims.text: Your notes (Postpartum Hemorrhage row) define it as > 500 mL after vaginal delivery or > 1000 mL after C-section, or loss needing transfusion or a 10% drop in hematocrit.
claims.quote: Bleeding >500mL (vaginal delivery) or >1000mL (c-section) – loss requiring transfusion or a 10% decrease in hematocrit

claims.text: The current definition uses one threshold for any delivery: > 1000 mL, or blood loss with signs of hypovolemia, within 24 hours.
claims.quote: Postpartum hemorrhage is blood loss of > 1000 mL or blood loss accompanied by symptoms or signs of hypovolemia within 24 hours after childbirth.
